sentences.en: I've decided to contribute Spanish sentences purely all this month.
sentences.zh: 我决定这个月纯粹为了贡献西班牙语句子。

sentences.en: I only found out about it purely by accident.
sentences.zh: 我只是偶然才得知这件事。

sentences.en: I wish to resign from my work for purely personal reasons.
sentences.zh: 我出于完全个人的原因想辞职。

senses.zh: 纯粹地；贞淑地；清洁地；完全地；仅仅，只不过
